_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Electric Load and Power Source Capacity Report
summary: Specifies requirements for an electric load and power source capacity analysis report to ensure robustness of electric power systems in aircraft or equipment.
use_relationship:
The electric load and power source capacity analyses report shall consider all aircraft or equipment operating conditions in order to ascertain or maintain robustness of each electric power system in the aircraft or equipment.  This Data Item Description (DID) may be applied to analyses requirements of special-purpose electric systems (e.g. electrical systems in backup mode, independent engine ignition and control generator systems, general-purpose electric systems, etc.).

This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information  for the data product resulting from the work task described by the contract statement of work (SOW).
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The report format shall be prepared in accordance with latest version of detail specification, Electric Load and Power Source Capacity, Aircraft, Analysis of, MIL-E-7016, section 3.3, 3.4, and its subsections.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The report content shall be prepared in accordance with latest version of detail specification, Electric Load and Power Source Capacity, Aircraft, Analysis of, MIL-E-7016, section 3.5 and its subsections.
